comment: Literal substitutions applied to shared/benchmarks.json by scripts/sync_benchmarks.sh (via scripts/catalog_overrides.py). The retail-joins suite's literals name rows in the benchmark's OWN generated dataset; our apps load Microsoft's shipped dataset, so these point at REAL Microsoft rows instead (see shared/data/manifest.json -> catalog_anchors). Never hand-edit shared/benchmarks.json; edit this file and re-run sync_benchmarks.sh.
